title: Savoy Dumps Whitewright To Win Red River Valley Basketball Crown
text:
Savoy Dumps Whitewright To Win Red River Valley Basketball Crown

BELLS—You can add the Red River Valley cage title to the growing list of titles won by Coach Weldon Nelson's District 45-B basketball champions from Savoy.

Last night on this neutral court the Cardinals ripped the terrific Tigers of Coach Glenn Howard of Whitewright by 36 to 28 to win the rubber game between the two clubs.

Whitewright had hammered out an eleven point triumph on its home court only to lose by nine points in a return game at Savoy.

The Whitewright Tigers went on to win [?] 27-B district crown and subsequent playoff and will head for Dallas Thursday for the regional tourney. Savoy departs Thursday for Kilgore where the Cards meet Quitman at 3:15 p.m. in the opening game of the regional session.

Savoy jumped to a 17 to 13 half-time lead and then turned on the steam during the third period to pull out in front by 15 points at one time. They wound up coasting home winner by 36 to 28.

Scoring was evenly divided between the Savoy cagers with A. J. Flanagan high with ten points while [?] Lew[?], [?] [?] [?], Denise Beckham each having nine and Pete Newell cashing in with eight.

However, high honors for the evening went to the Tigers' Herman Musser who pitched home 11 points.

In the growing excitement of the first regional tournament in history for the Savoy boys team, Coach Nelson failed to have his score book handy this morning for a box score on the contest.

"I hope winning that game is a good omen," said the Cardinal coach, who also is superintendent of the Savoy schools.

By Walt Blitz[?]
